findings.issue: Three validation error scenarios documented in interview.yml error_scenarios block (lines 702-708) are absent from Критерії приёмки: (1) POST with missing/empty name → 400 `name_required`; (2) POST with description > 200 chars → 400 `description_too_long`; (3) POST with missing timezone → 400 `timezone_required`. These were confirmed by the user in Q17 (AC list confirmation) and appear in the consolidated error_scenarios section of the interview.
findings.fix: Add three AC entries: AC-2b (or extend AC-2): POST with missing name → 400 `name_required`; AC-2c: POST with description > 200 chars → 400 `description_too_long`; AC-3b: POST with missing timezone → 400 `timezone_required`. Also verify that PATCH shares these validation rules.

findings.issue: AC-12 (PATCH) covers only the happy path (valid body → 200). There is no AC for PATCH when the new name conflicts with another active project of the same owner. The interview establishes 409 `project_name_taken` for rename conflicts (interview.yml line 550: 'rename (409 on duplicate active name)', line 851: '409 for active-name conflict on create/rename'), but this is not reflected in the Критерії приёмки. Without an explicit AC, the rename conflict path has no testable criterion.
findings.fix: Add AC-12b: PATCH /api/v1/projects/{id} with a name matching another ACTIVE project of the same owner → 409, code `project_name_taken`.

findings.issue: AC-17 emits `project_hard_deleted` per deleted project and states the event 'НЕ видаляється в каскаді' (is not deleted in cascade). However the spec does not include an AC verifying that the hard-delete cron does NOT remove the `project_hard_deleted` event itself from the events collection. This is a non-trivial invariant (the job deletes events WHERE metadata.projectId IN deleted_set, but the hard-deleted event has userId scope, not projectId scope) that has no explicit testable criterion.
findings.fix: Extend AC-17 or add AC-17b: after cron hard-delete, query events collection — events with type `project_hard_deleted` for the deleted projectId are present; events with `metadata.projectId == deleted_id` and type != `project_hard_deleted` are absent.

findings.issue: AC-22 lumps three distinct PATCH sub-flows (rename, description edit, timezone change) and one DELETE sub-flow into a single untestable compound criterion. 'Settings page дозволяє rename / опис / timezone через PATCH; danger zone delete вимагає ввести назву проекту дослівно' cannot be checked by a single test or manual step — each sub-flow is independently verifiable and independently failable. Compound AC reduces traceability.
findings.fix: Split AC-22 into: AC-22a: Settings page renders name/description/timezone fields pre-populated from current project; PATCH on save returns 200 + updated project. AC-22b: Danger zone 'Delete' button is disabled until user types project name verbatim (case-sensitive); on match button enables and triggers DELETE.

findings.issue: Q20 (minor_deferrals) confirmed specific i18n copy keys for the delete-confirm modal: `errors.projects.delete.confirmTypeName` with UA text 'Введіть «{name}» для підтвердження' and EN text 'Type «{name}» to confirm'. These are not mentioned anywhere in the user-spec (not in Ограничения, Технические решения, or Как проверить). They were explicitly captured in the interview as implementation defaults to be carried forward.
findings.fix: Add to Технические решения or a new 'Implementation defaults' subsection: i18n key `errors.projects.delete.confirmTypeName`; UA: 'Введіть «{name}» для підтвердження'; EN: 'Type «{name}» to confirm'. Or reference in AC-31 alongside other i18n keys.

findings.issue: The interview Q7 summary (lines 128, 242) states 422 for `invalid_timezone`, but the consolidated error_scenarios block (line 707-708) and AC list (line 594) in the same interview.yml use 400. The user-spec consistently uses 400 throughout (AC-3, Як проверить step 8, Тестирование). The user-spec is internally consistent and aligned with the codebase pattern (bean-validation → 400 via GlobalErrorHandler). However the discrepancy in Q7 summary vs the rest of the interview could confuse tech-spec authors reading both documents.
findings.fix: No change needed in user-spec (400 is correct per codebase patterns and the interview's own error_scenarios block). Add a note in Технические решения clarifying: '@ValidTimezone is a bean-validation annotation; validation failures surface as 400 (not 422) via GlobalErrorHandler — consistent with existing validation patterns.'

findings.issue: The 'Як проверить' section uses 'Користувач перевіряє' (Ukrainian) for the second subsection, while the template specifies 'Пользователь проверяет' (Russian) and the reference spec (04-remember-me-cookie) also uses Russian. All other section headers in the user-spec are correctly in Russian. This is an inconsistency with the template and reference style.
findings.fix: Rename '### Користувач перевіряє' to '### Пользователь проверяет'.

findings.issue: 31 acceptance criteria and 6 user flows exceed the warning thresholds (>10 AC, >3 flows). However size: L is declared and the scope (new backend module + REST endpoints + JobRunr cron + Pinia store + 4 new pages + i18n + PK update) genuinely warrants L. The thresholds are advisory for size-check warning, not a defect in the spec.
findings.fix: No action required. Size L is correctly declared for the scope. The warning threshold is exceeded proportionally to the declared size.

summary: Специфікація добре структурована, охоплює 20 з 21 рішень інтерв'ю та містить детальні сценарії і ризики з митигаціями. Виявлено два критичних знахідки: відсутні AC для трьох валідаційних помилок (name_required, description_too_long, timezone_required), підтверджених в інтерв'ю, та відсутній AC для конфлікту імені при PATCH (rename → 409 project_name_taken). Ці прогалини потребують виправлення перед затвердженням.
